faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Deputy Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur is 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Deputy Project Manager at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Deputy Project Manager position in the IIT Kanpur recruitment drive. Interested candidates should check the official notification for detailed distribution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Deputy Project Manager posts at IIT Kanpur is Online. Candidates need to visit the official website and fill out the application form electronically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Deputy Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The salary for the Deputy Project Manager post at IIT Kanpur ranges from Rs. 23000 to Rs. 59000 Per Month. Specific details are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Deputy Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have CA/ICWA/CS, or a Post Graduate degree with 5 years of relevant experience, or a Graduate degree with 8 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Deputy Project Manager post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Deputy Project Manager recruitment at IIT Kanpur. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Deputy Project Manager at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Deputy Project Manager position at IIT Kanpur involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule after shortlisting.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the IIT Kanpur Deputy Project Manager Recruitment 2026 can be accessed via the "Official Notification PDF" link in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.answer: The official website for Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is https://www.iitk.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply online.
